ir.name: loss_margin_rank_blend_tanh_max_advantage_weighted_mean_agg
ir.intuition: Transforms the pairwise margin ranking loss with tanh smoothing and weightings by max advantages, aggregating via weighted mean for numerical stability and runtime compatibility.
ir.pseudocode:
lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
adv_w = batch['advantage_w']
adv_l = batch['advantage_l']
weight = batch['weight']
alpha = extra.get('alpha', 1.0)
adv_max = maximum(adv_w, adv_l)
margin = lpw - lpl
scaled_margin = alpha * margin
clamped_margin = clamp(scaled_margin, -10, 10)
smooth_margin = tanh(clamped_margin)
hinge = relu(1 - smooth_margin)
loss = hinge * abs(adv_max) * weight
final_loss = mean(loss)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    eps = 1e-8
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    adv_w = batch['advantage_w']
    adv_l = batch['advantage_l']
    weight = batch['weight']
    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', 1.0))
    adv_max = ops.maximum(adv_w, adv_l)
    margin = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    scaled_margin = ops.mul(alpha, margin)
    clamped_margin = ops.clamp(scaled_margin, -10.0, 10.0)
    smooth_margin = ops.tanh(clamped_margin)
    hinge = ops.relu(ops.sub(ops.ones_like(smooth_margin), smooth_margin))
    loss = ops.mul(hinge, ops.abs(adv_max))
    loss = ops.mul(loss, weight)
    return ops.mean(loss)
